question:
If you follow these instructions, do you return to the starting point? Turn around. Turn around. Take 7 steps. Take 6 steps. Take 5 steps.
Options:
- Yes
- No

So, if I was facing west after the first turn, turning around again would make me face east once more.
So, after two turns, I'm back to my original direction.
